For a girl with a horse-face.

nodes.text: You've got really nice hair...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Today, I'm about to offer you the most powerful weapon in a player's arsenal. I'm going to teach you all about 'The Neg'!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Listen, I just wanted to say that, um, your hair looks really nice. You know, it's got a real nice sheen. Like it's covered in oil. But the good kind of oil.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Nice, uh, nice hair. That's all.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What the...?! Is this some kind of trick? You've never said a nice thing to me in your life!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Sure I have!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Last week, you said that I looked like a Fangmonster from the Swamps of Stenchburps!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: That's because you said you wouldn't run my story!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: We're not running it because it's about 'Space Captain Spudd' winning back 'Galactic Princess Katt' from the evil 'Lord Bren-Dan'!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It's an allegory!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, that's our cue to get going! Come on Spud, you old kidder you, let's go do some math homework!
Hector drags Spud outside.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I really blew it, huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes. Yes, you did. Now go home and think about what went wrong!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Nothing. I was just, uh, wondering what you were reading. But it's no big deal. I'm cool either way.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Um, okay... I was skimming through this paper I'm writing for English class. It feels like it's missing something, but I can't figure out what.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What's the topic?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Symbolism in 'The Crepes of Bath'...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Did you get the baby porcupine symbolizing new birth and prickliness?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Yeah, I got that, and I also got the orange fields symbolizing hope for the future!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well, how about the bulldozers? Those symbolize man's inhumanity to man and also totally sweet wrecking power!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Hey! That's really good! I missed that!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Thanks, Spud!
Spud wanders back over to Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did it work? Did you guys talk? It totally looked like you two were bonding!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yeah! I guess I'm better at this than I thought!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What're we doing here again? Am I really gonna learn how to have game... In the library?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We've got to start slow, okay? Where else are you even gonna have a shot?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now then. The most important part of being a player is having confidence. A dude with a healthy amount of confidence can overcome anything.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'm... I'm plenty confident...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Your knees are shaking.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: That's genetic!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, Spud, you might not believe it, but I wasn't always the coolest guy in the world. In fact, a couple years ago, I was a totally gross nerd!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh yeah. Playing video games all day... Showering once a week... Practice-kissing my pillow...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What was that last one?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The point is, the only way I became cool was by forcing myself to act cool! That's all confidence is, man... It's faking it 'til you make it!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: So how do I fake it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You walk up to that girl over there and start up a conversation!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Ashley? But I know her... We don't really get along...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go! Talk to her! Now!
Hector shoves Spud over towards Ashley, who is going over some papers...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Um, hi there, uh, Ashley...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Oh, hey, Spud. If this is about your short story, I still don't think we can run it in the student magazine...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: No! No, it's not about that at all... It's, uh, well... I kind of wanted to... What I mean to say is...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Gah! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no. Please, no. This is spiraling totally out of control...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Relax! I'm feeling good about this!
Four hours later, outside of the Centerscore Police Station...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And you're lucky I'm letting you off with just a warning!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not a word, Spud. Not one word.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll be right back! Don't go anywhere!
Hector runs off.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I don't know if I feel comfortable with this... Maybe this is getting out of hand... Maybe I should...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hey! That's Brendan! And he's walking in a pretty sneaky manner!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hector told me to wait here... But he's also been telling me I need to have more initiative!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: That does it! I'm going after Brendan!
Spud silently stalks Brendan through the hallways...
And into the Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What's he doing here? I'll just hide behind this car and find out!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hi, Brendan! You ready to work on this article for the journalism class?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You bet! Thanks for meeting me in secret, by the way. You know how Kat can be.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. Let's go work at the table...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Brendan's meeting with Dinah on the sly? That'll drive Kat nuts! Talk about gathering intel!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: This is way better than whatever Hector had planned!
Spud stalks Brendan sneakily through the school until...
Brendan's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hello? Oh, hey there! Yeah, I'm on my way to our meeting spot!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's so weird though. I just have this weird feeling that someone's following me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh? A private eye? Yeah, that does sound like the kind of thing Kat would do. Good point.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right. Forget meeting up today. I'll just go home.
Brendan briskly jogs off.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Shoot... I guess I could've been a lot sneakier...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! What the heck, man?! Where were you?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Sorry, Hector. I tried following Brendan around...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Why are you holding a psychiatry textbook?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's for my 'Fake Psychiatrist' costume! I gave up looking for you and tried to interrogate Kat all on my own!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Did you find out any intel?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No... But it turns out she's got a latent fear of ducks!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'm going home...
Spud stalks Brendan through the school until...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: A-CHOOO!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What the... Are you stalking me?!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What? Huh? No! I mean... Stalking is such a strong word...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dude, this is not cool! You are seriously out of your mind!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: What's going on here? Spud, are you stalking my boyfriend?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He totally was! Plus he kind of sneezed on me!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: That is so gross, Spud. Just leave me alone!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Let's get out of here, Brendy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought I asked you not to call me that...
Kat and Brendan walk off.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Wait! Come back! I... I...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Tell me you didn't just blow our cover. `Tell me` you didn't just mess this all up.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tell me you didn't just blow our cover. [color=#e23b3b][i]Tell me[/i][/color] you didn't just mess this all up.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Whatever. So, what's next? Hacking her computer? Tapping her phone lines? Because I think I can set up a pretty good wiretap...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, I dunno, man. Maybe it's time we focused on other things...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Why? You don't think there's any more intel we could gather?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure there's more we could gather... Just not without violating half a dozen privacy laws!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We've gathered so much intel, `I'm` starting to feel creepy! And that's a reach, you know?
nodes.text_bbcode: We've gathered so much intel, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] starting to feel creepy! And that's a reach, you know?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hmm...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nice! That's my kind of girl!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, sorry. I'll be totally professional, I promise.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Meet me outside the arcade in an hour!
Hector strolls into the arcade, and, with a quick check of his breath, walks over to Kat's side.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey there, hot stuff. You're an awfully pretty girl for a place like this!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Huh? Are you hitting on me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, yeah. Who else would I be hitting on?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I dunno... That punk girl over there?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh wow, she is pretty hot... You wait here! I'll be right back!
A while later, in the parking lot of the arcade...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, man! How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: How's it going? `How's it going?` I've been sitting here waiting for the last three hours!
nodes.text_bbcode: How's it going? [color=#e23b3b][i]How's it going?[/i][/color] I've been sitting here waiting for the last three hours!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I... I was gathering intel on Kat...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh really? That's a little hard to believe, given that I saw Kat walk out of there ten minutes after you walked in, complaining about some creep hitting on her!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Is... Is that black lipstick on your face? Were you making out with a punk girl?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What can I say, Spud? A player's work is never done.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mmm, a gentle, soothing burn, like the fire under an aromatic cauldron of beef stew...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Sometimes I feel like you're just saying words.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, you just leave the details to me. Meet me outside the arcade in an hour!
Hector strolls into the arcade, and, with a quick check of his breath, walks over to Kat's side.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey there.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Huh? Do you know me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, we go to Centerscore High together. I saw you today and...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You looked sad.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Well... I am sad! You'd be sad too if your boyfriend didn't answer your calls!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go on...
Some time later, in the arcade parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: There you are! How'd it go? You took forever!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Spud, my man, I've been talking to Kat for the last two hours, and I've learned three things.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: One, she's insanely jealous of Dinah. Two, she's starting to fall out with Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And three, I never, ever want to talk to her again!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you're going to have a shot at getting this girl, you need to know exactly how dead set she is on Brendan. That's where I come in.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right now, she's down at the arcade, plunking away her quarters. I'm gonna go hit on her and get a feel for how open she is to a dude's advances!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I... I don't know if I'm comfortable with this... Or if it even makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh relax, you big baby. I'm not going to make out with her or anything. I'm just gonna test the waters!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I guess it's okay... If you promise no funny business...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, that is the furthest thing from my mind! Now help me out. What strategy should I use to hit on her?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Some girls like it when you come on hot and heavy, like a raging inferno... But other girls dig the slow, simmering burn. Which type do you think she is?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Um... I guess she'd like it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right. If we really want the juicy intel, then it's time for us to raise the stakes a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Spud... I'm going in.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's what I was hoping you'd say! Today it's time for you to pull the classic intel-gathering routine... The 'Fake Psychiatrist'!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We'll just get you in costume and... Aw shoot! I left the shirt and fake moustache in the trunk of my car!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Really? Really? You think that's the screen name she'll like? Really?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'm sure of it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right... Whatever you say.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Really?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Really?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: `YES!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YES![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Fine, fine. 'Game-Stud' it is... There! The profile's done! Now we just play the waiting game.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I'll be... She already accepted it!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Told you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's see what this thing says... Oh, nice! She updates her status a lot! We can see what she's doing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: '2:52 - Kat is... Wondering where her stupid no-good not-calling-her boyfriend is!'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: '2:54 - Kat is... REALLY UPSET that her boyfriend hasn't called her!'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: '2:56 - Kat is... Researching tracking chips... Hmm...'

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Spud, my man, I think we've stumbled upon some trouble in Paradise!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: NerdGrrrl? Why a girl?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh, Kat's always really wanted a close female friend...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I can't argue with that. We'll just fill this thing out... And... Profile complete! Now we play the waiting game!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What's that? Did she accept?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No... It's a 'Buddy' request from someone else! 'Dextrous-Dexter'...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What the... Dexter's got an account? Accept it! Read it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Let's see. Turn-ons are 'Pwning Noobs' and 'Getting phat loot'... Interested in 'Anything I Can Get'... Nickname is 'King of the Nerds'...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: WHAT?!
Two hours later, in the parking lot of the arcade...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: WHO'S THE KING OF THE NERDS?!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: YOU ARE!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I CAN'T HEAR YOU!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: YOU'RE THE KING OF THE NERDS, SIR!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Now, kiss my feet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is really, really weird.
Later, after Dexter has run off sobbing...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I guess we didn't get any info on Kat, huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No. But I got way too much info about you!
A few minutes later, Hector and Spud are in the school library, seated by a computer.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Uh, what are we doing here? I thought we were spying on Kat!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, quiz time. If you wanna know what's going on in a girl's life, what's the easiest way to find out?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Call her mom and cry until she tells you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! Good gravy, no! You check her profile on AceBook!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: AceBook?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... You know, the social networking Web site?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh, I don't sign up for any Web sites where I can't be a Dwarven Barbarian. It's discrimination!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you know what else is discrimination?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When girls don't date dudes whose biggest accomplishment in life is being able to play the theme from 'Star Sores' on an ocarina!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Touche.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now, then. Let's see here. Just type in her name... Match it with 'Centerscore High'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, man! Her profile is 'Buddies Only'! We're gonna have to make a fake account and get her to 'Buddy' us!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know this girl, Spud. What sort of username would she be likely to 'Buddy'?

nodes.text: The next day, after school...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Spud. What's the game plan today?
If you were Spud, and we were Hector, we'd probably say... 'You did well, little buddy, but just not well enough!'
Then we'd probably wander off to go flirt with some girl, and you'd try again to get the perfect ending and the bonus scene!
We've kind of lost track of this metaphor, but you know what to do... Give it another shot!
Kat sighs deeply.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Look, Spud. It's true that things haven't been great with Brendan lately.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: And I don't know what's going on with you right now, but I'll admit you seem a lot cooler.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: But we're done, okay? And fancy clothes and smooth lines aren't gonna change that!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What?! Hector promised me this would work! What do I do now?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Wait! Kat!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: What now, Spud?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'm gonna lay it all on the line, Kat. You're pretty, funny, and way too cool to be dating a guy like Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I know I wasn't the best boyfriend. I know I wasn't there for you when you needed me.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: But I promise, Kat... I can change! I can be there for you! I can be the mature, strong, sophisticated man that you deserve!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Spud... I never knew you had this side...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Kat... There's a lot about me you don't know.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oh, Spud!
Kat steps forward and kisses Spud!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oh no! What have I done?! What did I do?! I just cheated on Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: But that's okay, right? Don't you want to be with me now?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yes! No! I don't know! I'm so confused!
Kat runs off!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Spud! I've been looking all over for you! I need to tell you that...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: She kissed me, Hector! She kissed me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She did, huh...?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yeah! And it wasn't because of my looks or my game or the intel! It was because I told her how I really, honestly feel!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where is she now?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh, she ran off confused... But I'm sure if I keep telling her how I feel, she'll come around!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Thanks for all the help, Hector! I'll take it from here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Spud! Wait! I...
Spud runs off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw man... What have I done? Brendan's gonna be devastated!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's wrong, Hector? You look like you just got punched in the gut!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Naw, it's not that... I've just got that tingly feeling I get when I've made a terrible mistake!
Congratulations! You turned Spud's life around and turned a nerd into a player!
Of course, Hector's not too happy about it... But maybe it's time he learned a lesson about being careful what he wishes for!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I think he's a vampire!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: What are you talking about?!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Let me put it to you this way, Kat. Have you ever seen him sleep?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yes! I watch him sleep all the time! Why do you think I set up that webcam?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh... Well, in that case, I've got nothing.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Please take me back? Please, please, please, please, please!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Stop it! You're embarrassing yourself!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Please?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Are you joking? You look fifty times worse than the last time I saw you! You look like a total wreck!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Even my hair?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Especially your hair!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Aww...
And so, the next day... It's the day of the big tournament!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: School is about to start, which means Kat is grabbing a snack... If I'm going to ask her to come with me, I gotta do it now!
Spud enters the cafeteria and walks over to where Kat is sitting.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hey there.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Ugh, what do you want, Spud?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Look, I know we didn't part on the best of terms. But you should know that I've grown a lot these last couple of weeks! I'm a totally different man now!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oh, really?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I mean, take a good look at me. You're saying I don't look different?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Spud, cut to the chase. What exactly do you want?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It's time to lay down some game! Let's hope what Hector taught me works!
Kat glances around nervously.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Look, Spud, I really can't talk to you right now.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I know. You don't want Brendan to see us together. But there's something you need to know about him.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oh really? What?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Let's hope I've got something good!

nodes.text: School has just let out at Centerscore High, and local lothario Hector is strolling to his car... When he hears a girlish crying from somewhere nearby!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa, that sounds like one distraught lady!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe I should keep walking... The last thing I need in my life is a bunch of weepy girl drama...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: On the other hand, she might be hot... And it's like Dad always says, 'There's only one way to comfort a grieving widow!'

nodes.text: Hey, baby, why are you crying...

nodes.text: Man, relax, would you? That doesn't even make sense!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Waaaaaah! I said go away!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I said relax! If you don't want people seeing you, maybe you shouldn't be crying so loud! I heard you from halfway across the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh... Sniffle, sniffle... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's your problem, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It's... It's my ex-girlfriend... We were supposed to go to the big 'Ogres and Elves' tournament together...

nodes.text: It's not a lame tournament! It's the biggest nerd event of the year! Taking your girlfriend there is like the most romantic thing you can do!

nodes.text: But now she's dating that Brendan guy and won't even pick up the phone when I call!

nodes.text: Whoa! Kat's your ex?

nodes.text: Ugh! Ever since Brendan started dating Kat, our whole friendship's fallen apart! That girl's a total nightmare!

nodes.text: I'd do anything to get her back! She's the sun in my sky! The jewel in my crown! The +2 Fortitude Dagger in my Dragonskin Sheath!

nodes.text: Dude, cut it out with the metaphors! I'm getting that tingly feeling I get whenever I come up with a good idea!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I can get Spud and Kat back together... Then maybe my friendship with Brendan will go back to normal!

nodes.text: Listen, you gotta understand... This situation isn't hopeless!

nodes.text: Isn't that stalking?
